rawContent: Until political leaders understand the level of our #ClimateEmergency and take appropriate action, this number will continue to rise. Our planet has not seen this levels since the beginning of human history. How can you say climate change is not human-caused?

I hate to be doom and gloom... but this sh*t is scary... as is our general population turning their back on this data and science. One more response to our #ClimateChange research article tweets with “but chem trails!” may illicit a scream from the 4th floor!

My Life in CO2. Soon to be a >100ppm increase in my lifetime  (I am 44). 

Birth year: 331.15 ppm
High school graduation: 357.04 ppm
College grad: 363.76 ppm
Marriage: 387.35 ppm
First House: 391.63 ppm
Masters: 400.84 ppm
Today: 415.40 ppm

What is yours? #ClimateEmergency
Okay— so I have been hollering about our #ClimateEmergency a couple times this week. But do want to remind folks that we did find a bright spot in #ClimateEducation.
Another piece highlighting our paper in @NatureClimate about intergenerational learning and #climatechange education. Go Team! @NCSU_EELab @DanielleFLawson @drktstevenson https://t.co/ANXIrgoLTh
